newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices were mostly steady on Thursday amid continued featureless activity ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday week, dealers said.
"For the last two weeks now, the only thing people are buying is really nearby," a Texas dealer said.
There has just been a truck here and there, and that is it, a Minneapolis dealer said. But he noted that the market was steady and not trending downward.

People are more concerned about logistical problems than the actual market right now, a St Louis dealer said. He referred to the downtimes expected to be taken by flour mills next week which would prompt dealers to scramble for supplies.
Supply becomes a problem, he said.
